votes.motion: Approve permission for Rene Trakimas to use the property for the annual Sunrise Stables Harvest Ride event.
votes.quote: kj moved to approve permission to use the property for the annual event. cc seconded and the motion was approved unanimously.

votes.motion: Allow the 914 Flatt Hill change of scope as a field change, with conditions that the dock be removed this winter and no elevation changes.
votes.quote: this was approved by a motion of kj and a second by jr

votes.motion: Continue the Hemlock Road Notice of Intent (MJN Realty Trust) to September 19, 2018.
votes.quote: cc moved to continued and cl seconded and the commission voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Continue the Hickory Hills Association drawdown management plan Notice of Intent to September 19, 2018.
votes.quote: the commission continued to september 19, 2018 with a motion of kj and a second by cc. the commission unanimously approved the motion.

votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for the rolling dock, steps and Tiki Hut at 667 Reservoir Road, with the condition that the dock have a put in and take out date consistent with the drawdown season.
votes.quote: bp moved to issue a negative determination with the conditions that the dock have "put in and take out date" consistent with the drawdown season. cl seconded and the commission voted unanimously

votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for tree removal at 4 Brookview, with conditions that no trees be dropped into the lake and the stumps be ground in place.
votes.quote: cl seconded and the commission unanimously approved the motion.

votes.motion: Approve the Eagle Scout project to repair the snow mobile bridge at the Cowdery and allow 1500 dollars for reimbursement of expenses.
votes.quote: the commission approved the project and allowed for 1500 dollars for reimbursement of expenses by a motion of kj and a second by cc.

votes.motion: Issue a standard Order of Conditions for the barn at 18 Gilchrest Street.
votes.quote: kj moved for a standard order of conditions, jr seconded and the commission voted unanimously.

votes.motion: Approve a partial Certificate of Compliance for lot 7 at 350 Sunset Lane, with work continuing on lot 4.
votes.quote: the commission voted 4-1 to approve a partial coc for lot 7 with work continuing on lot 4.

note: Extracted text is typo-heavy and some lines are run together. Initials are used without expansion: CL and Cl, CC and cc, BP, KJ, JR, MM, RB. Whether "Cl" means Carl Luck or Catie Childs is not clear from the text, so the seconder names are kept as printed. The Hickory Hills motion records no count. The 350 Sunset Lane vote is printed as 4-1 with RB abstaining, and no mover is recorded. The Selectmen's 4-1 vote on the Gilchrest land exchange is not a commission vote and is excluded. The minutes approval item shows no recorded vote. The 914 Flatt Hill approval records no count. Gary Gouldrup and Caleb Slater are mentioned but are not recorded as taking part, so they are not listed as attendees.
